# VJC Partners

> Smartsourcing for Australian accountants. VJC Partners is an offshore accounting partner working exclusively with Australian accounting firms, CPA practices and tax agents, delivering bookkeeping, payroll, year-end accounting, tax compliance and SMSF work inside the firm's own software, processes and standards.

Founded in 1988 as a Chartered Accountancy firm, VJC has spent close to four decades on the partner side of the desk. Today VJC Partners works as the remote team for Australian accounting firms, aligned to Australian accounting standards, ATO requirements and the compliance frameworks each practice already runs on.

Smartsourcing is VJC's term for a strategic outsourcing partnership rather than a cost-cutting one. Traditional outsourcing focuses on reducing cost. Smartsourcing entrusts the core, judgement-driven areas of a firm's compliance practice to a team that works within the firm's own software, processes and standards, with every job prepared, reviewed and overseen by accountants the firm knows and works with directly.

Key facts:
- Established 1988. 38+ years of accounting, audit and tax experience.
- 3000+ projects completed across 40+ industries served.
- 50% women workforce.
- Every job handled by a qualified accountant with a minimum of three years' Australian accounting and compliance experience.
- All work supervised and reviewed by Chartered Accountants.
- Delivered inside the client firm's own stack: Xero, MYOB, BGL, Class Super, Karbon, FYI, LodgeiT, Dext, Hubdoc, QuickBooks, Reckon, Sage, NowInfinity, Practice Protect and more.
- Named team on every engagement: a dedicated accountant, manager, Director and Client Success Partner. No anonymous desks and no rotation.
- No lock-in contracts and no exit penalties.
- ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Certified Company. GDPR compliant.
- Free trial available on one real job from the firm's own portfolio, at no cost and with no obligation.
- Every discovery call is hosted by the Growth & Partnerships team with a VJC director on the line.
- Leadership: Vijay Jaiswal (Founder), Mayank Berlia (Director, Operations), Prachi Priya (Director, Growth).
- Location: Pakenham, VIC, Australia, 3810.

## Solutions

- [Bookkeeping Outsourcing](https://www.vjcpartners.com/solutions/bookkeeping-outsourcing): Day-to-day bookkeeping, reconciliations and workpapers prepared inside the firm's existing software, ready for review and sign-off.
- [Payroll & Compliance Outsourcing](https://www.vjcpartners.com/solutions/payroll-outsourcing): Payroll processing and associated compliance obligations handled to Australian requirements.
- [Year-End Accounting & Financial Statement](https://www.vjcpartners.com/solutions/year-end-financials-outsourcing): Year-end accounts and financial statements prepared with full supporting workpapers and queries cleared.
- [Tax Compliance Outsourcing](https://www.vjcpartners.com/solutions/tax-compliance-outsourcing): Tax returns, BAS and lodgement preparation aligned to ATO requirements and the firm's own review process.
- [SMSF Compliance Outsourcing](https://www.vjcpartners.com/solutions/smsf-outsourcing): SMSF fund accounting and compliance work prepared in BGL, Class Super or the firm's nominated platform.

## Engagement Models

- [Engagement Models](https://www.vjcpartners.com/engagement-models): Four ways to engage VJC. Full Time Equivalent (FTE), a dedicated qualified accountant working 8 hours per business day, same person every month with no rotation. Part Time Equivalent (PTE), a half-seat at 4 hours per business day with the same qualification standard, scalable to FTE without re-onboarding. Job by Job (JBJ), per-job pricing with no monthly commitment, suited to tax-season surge or one-off SMSF work. Dedicated Task Team (DTT), a fully managed pod of three or more people under a Chartered Accountant covering multiple solution lines as an extended back office.
